limits.difyTracePrivacy: Dify may retain workflow inputs, HTTP request bodies and output vectors in run history; restrict access and retention there. The Google key is supplied through the Dify secret environment variable and custom API-key authorization header.
limits.textBoundRationale: The workflow uses a conservative 1536 UTF-8 byte cap per text and disables Google truncation; it does not tokenize locally, so any provider token-limit rejection fails the run visibly.

provider.name: Google Gemini API via Dify HTTP Request
provider.requestFieldCompatibility: Send matching taskType and outputDimensionality both at EmbedContentRequest top level and in embedContentConfig; keep autoTruncate=false in embedContentConfig. The top-level fields are deprecated but remain in Google's batch request schema and are required by this release's tested wire shape.
